summary: Orkyo Community is a self-hosted production scheduling tool designed for manufacturing teams. It provides a centralised plan to coordinate machines, operators, and tooling required to execute jobs. Built with C# and containerised with Docker, it targets resource planning workflows on your own infrastructure.
goodFor: It is well-suited for small to medium manufacturing environments needing an open-source tool to track shop floor schedules and asset utilisation.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence requires you to release source modifications if you offer the software as a network service, and early-stage adoption carries typical community maturity risks.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based C# application, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
